title: Matterbridge haus plugin
description: Bridges the hausphone PWA's Z-Wave switches into Matter for Google Home

hausphoneUrl.description: Base URL of the hausphone app. Loopback works when both containers are on the NUC's host network.

tlsInsecure.description: Skip TLS verification for hausphone. Its cert is self-signed, so this normally stays on.

whiteList.description: Only bridge these device names. Empty bridges everything hausphone exports.

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
